primary.why: Company of Heroes remains available on Steam, and the Complete Pack includes the base game, Legacy Edition, Opposing Fronts, and Tales of Valor. A newly announced Definitive Edition is not yet available on Steam at this checkpoint, so the current complete Steam route is the practical primary for now.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam Windows build/Complete Pack. Record exact app/build, expansion ownership, widescreen/settings, mod/workshop state, and whether the future Definitive Edition has released before changing the primary route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Reassess after Company of Heroes - Definitive Edition releases; document any changed AI, UI, mod, or balance behavior.
